subject.title: Feature: Telegram Reactions - Two-Way Support with Prompt Guidance

question: Should Telegram reaction interpretation be added as a separately configurable prompt feature, or should the existing reaction-level/notification settings remain the only reaction behavior contract?
rationale: The request adds user-visible prompt semantics and a new configuration surface that overlaps existing Telegram reaction settings; source inspection is needed to select a safe permanent contract, but the supplied discussion already establishes that this is product direction rather than a strict bug repair.

options.title: Extend the existing contract
options.body: Define any incoming-reaction guidance as a documented extension of the current reaction-level and notification settings, avoiding a parallel `reactionGuidance` option.

options.title: Add a separate guidance setting
options.body: Add an explicit setting only after documenting precedence, upgrade behavior, default semantics, and why the existing controls cannot express the intended policy.

options.title: Keep transport-only reactions
options.body: Retain passive system events and outbound guidance without interpreting reactions as prompt-level soft calls to action.

recommendation.title: Extend the existing contract
recommendation.body: Define any incoming-reaction guidance as a documented extension of the current reaction-level and notification settings, avoiding a parallel `reactionGuidance` option.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied discussion shows this person already triaged the unresolved configuration and prompt-contract question.
